description: Validates the flow and, if it has no errors, saves it and returns a aistrategyminer.com Strategy Builder URL that opens it on the canvas. A link expires 90 days after the same flow was first saved. The user backtests there and, with Pro, downloads the source to compile in MetaEditor.

flows.description: Usually one flow. Several flows = a portfolio EA, one Start node each.

data.description: Parameter values keyed by property key

id.description: Unique within the flow, e.g. n1

settings.description: Shared EA settings (same shape as get_template settings); omit for defaults

name: create_builder_link
title: Create a Strategy Builder link
